business_process: Import entry filing and cargo release
description: Prepare and transmit entries and entry summaries; answer CBP holds and requests; obtain release so containers can leave the terminal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 18 entries a business day. After one business day, client containers start running into terminal free-time limits and demurrage charges that clients bill back; clients move freight to another broker quickly
manual_workaround: Entry Supervisor files urgent entries from a clean laptop through the platform's web interface; another broker files urgent entries under a standby arrangement (planned, not in place); notify clients of delays
dependent_third_parties: Customs platform vendor; internet provider; MSP; CBP systems
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner; Entry Supervisor; 2 Entry Writers; office suite

description: Collect ISF data from shippers and overseas agents and transmit the ISF before cargo is loaded abroad
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: ISFs have fixed timing tied to vessel loading abroad; a late or missing ISF exposes the importer to CBP penalties and cargo holds; about 16 ISFs a business day
manual_workaround: File the most time-critical ISFs first from any clean device through the platform's web interface; overseas agents resend data by email
dependent_third_parties: Customs platform vendor; overseas agents; productivity suite vendor

business_process: Duty, fee, and carrier and agent payments
description: Pay CBP for clients who prepay duties; wire ocean freight to carriers and overseas agents; post client funds
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Duty payments must reach CBP by the due date (111.29(a)); carriers hold cargo until freight is paid; a diverted wire is a direct loss (about $9 million a year passes through the account)
manual_workaround: Owner releases urgent wires from the bank portal on a clean device after phone call-back to a known number; statement-paying clients pay CBP directly
dependent_third_parties: Bank; accounting SaaS vendor; ocean carriers; overseas agents

description: Email and phone with clients, overseas agents, carriers, and truckers; shipment status updates
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Nearly every instruction, document, and status update moves by email; clients expect same-day answers
manual_workaround: Forward the office line to the owner's cell phone; reply from the platform's client notice feature; temporary mailbox from the suite on a clean device
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; phone carrier; MSP

description: Book space with carriers; coordinate overseas agents; issue arrival notices and delivery orders; book trucking through the broker partner; check container status
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bookings and delivery orders can slip a day without missing vessels; a missed vessel cutoff costs the client a week
manual_workaround: Book by phone with carrier sales offices; use carrier portals from any clean device
dependent_third_parties: Ocean carriers; terminals; overseas agents; trucking broker partner

description: Prepare and file Electronic Export Information as the exporter's authorized agent; keep export records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: EEI must be filed before export; about 5 export shipments a business day; records kept 5 years (15 CFR 30.10)
manual_workaround: Exporter files directly in the government export filing system for urgent shipments

business_process: Client onboarding and customs records management
description: New client POAs and CBP Form 5106 data; scanned Client Records Archive; answering CBP record requests within 30 days (111.25(b))
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: CBP gives 30 calendar days for record requests; new clients can wait a few days; losing archive data breaks the 5-year retention duty (111.23(b))
manual_workaround: Paper POA forms; restore requested files from the suite backup
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; backup service (MSP subcontractor); MSP

description: Invoice clients; collect duties and fees; reconcile bank and ledger; payroll through an outside service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Invoices can wait a few days; the cash reserve covers about 45 days
manual_workaround: Queue invoices; bank portal for balances; repeat prior payroll through the payroll service
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; bank; payroll service

description: eCBP submissions: employee list updates within 30 days (111.28(b)), point of contact and address updates within 10 days (111.30(a)), triennial status report, continuing education records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in days (10 or 30) or are annual; a week of outage does not miss one unless it falls at a deadline
manual_workaround: Update by email or letter to the processing Center if the portal or EDI system is unavailable (111.28(b), 111.30)
